maya: Heads-up — APAC-sg satellite-edge pool reporting a shortfall. 6 units flagged DOA on intake, vendor says 4 replacements inbound but currently held by customs.
aj: Any AWB/manifest numbers so we can push docs? ETA?
maya: FreightCo says AWB CX123456789 is on hold, customs asked for supplementary invoice and COO. They emailed us at ops@freightco.com. RMA window is 72h from manifest release.
freightco: (vendor) Confirmed. We requested the missing paperwork from the shipper at 2024-03-04 09:15. Will update once cleared.
nina: If customs clearance drags past 48h we need to spin loaners or we'll start seeing task queue backpressure. Canary nodes already showing +30% latency on inference tail.
tomas: Is there any cheaper inland re-route (SIN depot) that avoids holding? How much time + cost?
freightco: Re-route to SIN inland would add ~12h transit + $250/unit handling. Air rebook (priority) gives ~6h clearance but costs ~$1.2k/unit.
maya: Tradeoffs: extra $250/unit vs risking degraded SLA for customers. These were reserved units for APAC commit, not spot. Finance has committed capacity for Q3.
aj: Correct — reserved commit. Recommend air-rebook for 3 units (critical canaries), re-route remaining 1 via SIN inland. That keeps launch on schedule with minimized SLA risk.
nina: Operational plan: I'll mark 2 EU loaners for hot-teleport to SG region as temporary capacity. I'll update k8s node taints and increase autoscaler headroom by 10%.
maya: Ok. Action items:
- maya: approve air rebook for 3 units (cost center: infra-proc).
- freightco: initiate rebook + share new AWBs and expected customs contact.
- nina: spin EU loaners -> APAC, update canary dashboard and alerts.
- aj: prepare serial reconciliation + RMA IDs sheet, tag affected clusters.

freightco: Rebook started. New AWBs below (ETA customs 6-8h):
```
AWB: CX987654321
AWB: CX987654322
AWB: CX987654323
```

maya: Thanks — please also confirm whether vendor can pre-send COO/invoice to customs agent to speed release.
freightco: We can pre-send COOs to agent-on-file, yes. Need signed supplier invoice PDF. ETA to agent once received: ~30-45m.
aj: Uploading serial list now and adding RMA notes. Sheet link: https://redwood.internal/pg-serials (internal) — will include mapping: serial -> cluster -> RMA#.
nina: Monitoring threshold: if queue growth >50% across inference pods for 2 consecutive hours i'll escalate to oncall SRE for cross-region failover.
maya: Also note: if air rebook used, procurement should expect uplift ~ $3.6k total for 3 units; please route to infra-proc budget.
freightco: Docs accepted by agent and pre-sent. New expected customs release in ~4h. Will post final AWB-clear note.
aj: Done updating spreadsheet and tagging support tickets. RMA IDs allocated: RMA-APAC-20240304-01..04.
maya: Great. Keep this thread for status. If customs slips beyond 8h let's re-evaluate full air uplift for remaining unit. :thumbsup:
